findings.issue: The entire data layer (search/type/generation predicates, pagination, dedup, ordering, text extraction) has no tests; any refactor is unguarded once the acceptance suite isn't run
findings.suggestion: Add vitest with a stubbed fetch and unit-test loadList, loadPokemon and cardsFor against small fixtures

findings.issue: Unknown type or generation query values (e.g. ?generation=bogus) filter out every species and render 'No Pokémon found' instead of being ignored
findings.suggestion: Decide the behaviour (ignore vs. not-found), fix it, and pin it with a test

findings.issue: Default move-row sort relies on the one-liner trick (level only for level-up, else label); easy to break in a refactor
findings.suggestion: Extract a tested sortMoves(method, rows) helper

findings.issue: Missing-values-last sort checks va === null; a refactor to a falsy check would mis-sort 0-power/0-PP moves
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator with 0 and null values in both directions

findings.issue: englishEffect's $effect_chance substitution and latestFlavorText's last-English-entry/whitespace rules are untested
findings.suggestion: Pure-function unit tests with fixture entries

findings.issue: Per-move dedup key `${method}:${level}` is undocumented and untested; changing it silently duplicates or drops rows
findings.suggestion: Test a Pokémon with the same move at multiple levels/methods

findings.issue: Cache size purge only evicts expired entries; with >5000 live entries the map grows without bound in a long-running server
findings.suggestion: Cap total entries or evict oldest, and test the eviction logic

findings.issue: humanize is coupled to search semantics (pokedex.server.ts:159 matches queries against the humanized name); the contract is unpinned
findings.suggestion: Unit-test humanize and the search-match function together

findings.issue: Search debounce (150 ms, replace-navigation) has race potential between typing and filter changes; untested
findings.suggestion: Test with fake timers that a rapid filter change cancels the pending query update

findings.issue: No `test` script or runner, so nothing app-owned can run in CI
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or Playwright component tests) and an `npm test` script

summary: The app ships with zero tests of its own — no runner, no script, no spec files — so all quality guarding is borrowed from the acceptance suite the agent was handed. The untested surface is large and concentrated in exactly the places future work will touch: the filter/pagination math, move-table ordering and dedup, text-extraction rules, and the in-memory cache. Two latent issues (unknown filter values showing 'No Pokémon found', and the unbounded cache) are exactly the kind of bug a handful of unit tests around pokedex.server.ts would have surfaced.
